summary: Both backend and frontend/integration tested against the deployed BASE (https://app-deploy-187.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — GET /api/state, PUT /api/state, /api/admin/login (401 wrong / 200 correct returns access_token), /api/admin/state 401 without token and 200 with Bearer token, PUT /api/admin/state auth-gated, /api/admin HTML served. Admin dashboard: wrong password shows 'Mot de passe incorrect' and stays on login; correct 'admin123' loads dashboard with 5 KPI cards + tabs (Réglages, Planteurs, Équipe, Collectes, Prêts, Mandats, Dépenses). In Réglages, changing 'Nom de la coopérative' to TEST_COOP_ADMIN and 'Prix bord champ' to 2100 + 'Enregistrer les réglages' persists across reload. In Planteurs tab, '+ Ajouter' opens the <dialog id='editor'> form; saving with [data-k] fields inserts row (Planteurs KPI 0->1) and is visible in public GET /api/state. Mobile app (390x844): after clearing the backend to empty and clearing localStorage, tapping 'Créer une coopérative' opens the coop form; filling 'Nom de la coopérative'='TEST_COOP_APP' + responsable='TEST_Patron' + 'Créer & accéder au tableau de bord' navigates to Patron Bilan AND writes coop.nom + a patron staff row to backend within ~2s (debounced PUT /api/state confirmed via GET). Backend->app sync: after admin PUT injects 'TEST_Admin_Added' planteur, reloading the app and logging back in as patron shows the new planteur in the Planteurs list. Regression: FAB visible on Patron dashboard, nav-planteurs tab active, add-member MemberSheet opens with all fields and validation gating (Enregistrer disabled until required fields filled) — this is expected. No red-screen, no console errors of concern. No deprecated Expo packages observed in backend/server.py or the tested screens.
action_items: None functional. Optional polish: In MemberSheet the 'Enregistrer' button is disabled until required fields are filled — consider surfacing an inline hint (e.g., red asterisk or a helper text) so users understand why the button is grey (currently there is no visible cue).

Optional: Consider distinct testIDs on MemberSheet fields (e.g., testID='member-nom', 'member-village', 'save-member') for more robust automated testing; currently only 'save-btn' and 'add-member' are exposed on this flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py load_state()/save_state() returns the raw {"data":..} dict without exposing MongoDB _id — good. STATE_ID = 'main' single-doc pattern is intentional (single shared DB per owner choice 4a).

Public PUT /api/state has NO authentication — matches the offline-first sync design, but note anyone on the internet can overwrite state. Consider a lightweight write token in the future if abuse becomes a concern (out of scope for this feature).

store.ts guards initial hydration with remoteApply.current so first-load doesn't echo back to server, and debounces subsequent pushes ~700ms. Working as designed and last-write-wins is documented behavior.
seed_data_creation: During testing I wrote transient markers via admin API: coop.nom set to TEST_COOP_ADMIN then TEST_COOP_APP, one planteur TEST_Planteur_Admin (via admin dashboard) and TEST_Admin_Added (via admin PUT), plus a patron staff TEST_Patron created via the app. Main agent should reset the shared state before releasing to the owner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE=https://app-deploy-187.preview.emergentagent.com, admin password admin123. Public GET/PUT /api/state is unauthenticated (by design). Single Mongo doc _id='main'. Admin dashboard is plain HTML at /api/admin; app is Expo web at /. To reset for a clean test: POST /api/admin/login -> PUT /api/admin/state with the empty_state() shape from backend/server.py. Debounce is ~700ms; wait ~2s before curling GET /api/state to observe app-side writes. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_valeo_api.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. The features (backend API, admin dashboard, app<->backend two-way sync via /api/state, and mobile regression) all work as specified.
